name: bb-plugin-homepage
description: Cards under the new-thread composer. The first, Activity, is six months of your merged GitHub PRs as a calendar grid, with the threads you started, PRs merged and lines changed; its data refreshes in the background, so it opens instantly. With PR Reviews installed, its pull requests card sits beside Activity.
